source: decomp/MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Events/{Neow,Orobas,Pael,Tezcatara,Nonupeipe,Tanx,Vakuu,Darv}.cs; act membership from MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Acts/{Overgrowth,Underdocks,Hive,Glory}.cs AllAncients/GetUnlockedAncients, ModelDb.AllSharedAncients and RunManager.GenerateRooms. Ids are the simulator's (sts2 names()['relic']); classes from data/relic_classes.json. Generated by a one-off script; acts are 1-based as the player sees them (game CurrentActIndex is 0-based).
notes: Act 1 ancient is always Neow (Overgrowth and Underdocks both list only Neow). Act 2 (Hive) rolls uniformly among Orobas, Pael, Tezcatara (+ Darv if assigned to act 2). Act 3 (Glory) rolls uniformly among Nonupeipe, Tanx, Vakuu (+ Darv if assigned to act 3).
ancient_weights '2' and '3' are marginals; Darv can never be the ancient of both acts, so sample act 3 from '3_given_act2_darv' / '3_given_act2_not_darv'.
ancient_weights assume Orobas and Darv are unlocked (OrobasEpoch, DarvEpoch); without Orobas act 2 is Pael/Tezcatara (+Darv).
by_act excludes MASSIVE_SCROLL (multiplayer only) and, at act 3, Darv's act-2-only ECTOPLASM and SOZU. Conditional relics (see each ancient's conditions) are included.
Every relic of catalog rarity Ancient (102) is offered by exactly one ancient; no offered relic is unknown to the simulator.

NEOW.offer: 3 options: 2 drawn (shuffle, take 2) from the positive list (positive pool + one of each coin-flip pair), 1 drawn from the curse pool

conditions.MASSIVE_SCROLL: multiplayer only (IsAllowed: Players.Count > 1); excluded from by_act (single player)
conditions.KALEIDOSCOPE: only if every character's card pool is unlocked
conditions.SCROLL_BOXES: only if the character pool has >= 4 unlocked commons and >= 2 unlocked uncommons

NEOW.note: Each coin-flip pair contributes exactly one relic to the positive list (50/50); pair a is skipped entirely when the curse option is LARGE_CAPSULE. NEOWS_BONES sits in the curse pool although it uses the POSITIVE done-text. Exclusions: the drawn curse removes the listed positive options. With run modifiers (custom/daily), Neow offers modifier options and no relics.

conditions.PRISMATIC_GEM: slot1 third candidate is PRISMATIC_GEM with p=1/3, else SEA_GLASS (p=2/3); slot1 then picks uniformly among 3
conditions.SEA_GLASS: parameterised by a random OTHER unlocked character (CharacterId); one sim id
conditions.TOUCH_OF_OROBAS: only if the player still has a Starter-rarity relic (SetupForPlayer). On pickup it REPLACES that starter with its upgrade (see starter_upgrades; any other starter -> CIRCLET). relic_classes.json marks it macro_only: the game keeps TOUCH_OF_OROBAS (inert, saved StarterRelic / UpgradedRelic ids) beside the upgraded starter
conditions.ARCHAIC_TOOTH: only if the deck has a transcendence starter card (SetupForPlayer)

OROBAS.note: Slot 3 shows a locked option (no relic) if neither TOUCH_OF_OROBAS nor ARCHAIC_TOOTH can be set up. Orobas is only in the act-2 pool once OrobasEpoch is unlocked.
OROBAS.source: decomp/.../Events/Orobas.cs; Hive.cs AllAncients (removed unless OrobasEpoch is revealed)

conditions.PAELS_CLAW: slot2 only if >= 3 deck cards can take the Goopy enchantment
conditions.PAELS_TOOTH: slot2 only if >= 5 removable deck cards
conditions.PAELS_LEGION: slot3 only if the player has no event pet

PAEL.note: Slot 2 list [WING, (+CLAW), (+TOOTH)] is doubled before GROWTH is appended, so GROWTH has weight 1 and each other entry weight 2.

conditions.NUTRITIOUS_SOUP: slot1 only if the deck holds a Basic-rarity Strike

NONUPEIPE.offer: 3 options drawn without replacement (shuffle, take 3) from one pool

conditions.BEAUTIFUL_BRACELET: only if >= 4 deck cards can take the Swift enchantment

TANX.offer: 3 options drawn without replacement (shuffle, take 3) from one pool

conditions.TRI_BOOMERANG: only if >= 3 deck cards can take the Instinct enchantment

VAKUU.offer: 3 options, one uniformly from each pool

conditions.SERE_TALON: the option also costs 9 max HP

DARV.offer: one relic per eligible set (each set is a single relic), shuffled; 50%: take 2 + DUSTY_TOME, else take 3

conditions.PANDORAS_BOX: not offered under a run modifier that clears the deck
conditions.DUSTY_TOME: offered in 50% of visits in place of the third option; gives an upgraded random Ancient card of the character (not a transcendence card)

DARV.note: Shared ancient: at run start the shared list is shuffled and for act 2 then act 3 a count NextInt(len+1) (0 or 1) of it is moved into that act's ancient pool, so Darv joins act 2's pool with p=1/2, else act 3's with p=1/2 (overall 1/4); it never appears in both acts.
DARV.source: decomp/.../Events/Darv.cs; ModelDb.AllSharedAncients; RunManager.GenerateRooms (shared ancients distributed over acts 2..3); UnlockState.SharedAncients (needs DarvEpoch)
